ab-wheel-rollout.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
cues: Kneel with the wheel below your shoulders; brace your trunk and roll forward.
Reach only as far as you can control your lower back, then roll back.
avoid: Avoid letting your lower back sag or pulling back by sitting onto your heels.

barbell-back-squat.name: Barbell Back Squat
cues: Set your feet at a comfortable width; brace and bend your hips and knees together.
Keep your whole foot planted, squat to a controlled depth, then stand.
avoid: Avoid losing foot contact or letting the load pull you out of balance.

barbell-bench-press.name: Barbell Bench Press
cues: Set a stable position on the bench and keep wrists over forearms.
Lower the weight toward your chest with control, then press it back up.
avoid: Avoid bouncing the weight or losing control of your shoulder position.

barbell-front-squat.name: Barbell Front Squat
cues: Rest the bar across the front shoulders; keep elbows lifted and brace.
Squat between your legs with full-foot contact, then stand without losing the rack position.
avoid: Avoid letting the bar roll off the shoulders or forcing a depth you cannot control.

barbell-hip-thrust.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
cues: Support your upper back on the bench, plant your feet, and secure the load over your hips.
Lift your hips until your trunk and thighs align; lower with control.
avoid: Avoid arching your lower back to lift the load higher.

barbell-romanian-deadlift.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Soften your knees, brace, and move your hips back while keeping the weight close.
Lower to a controlled hamstring stretch, then extend your hips to stand.
avoid: Avoid reaching lower by rounding your back or turning it into a squat.

barbell-row.name: Barbell Row
cues: Hinge at the hips and brace your torso with the weight hanging below you.
Pull toward your lower ribs or waist, then lower until your arms extend.
avoid: Avoid standing upright on each rep or jerking the weight.

bulgarian-split-squat.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Set your rear foot on a stable bench and plant the front foot for balance.
Bend the front knee to lower, then push through the front foot to rise.
avoid: Avoid wobbling on the platform or dropping the back knee.

cable-lateral-raise.name: Cable Lateral Raise
cues: Start with your arms low and elbows softly bent.
Raise your arms out to a comfortable shoulder height, then lower slowly.
avoid: Avoid shrugging or swinging your torso to lift the load.

chest-supported-dumbbell-row.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cues: Set your torso against the support or brace it in a stable position.
Pull the load toward your torso with your elbows, then let your arms extend slowly.
avoid: Avoid jerking with your trunk or letting the load pull you forward.

conventional-barbell-deadlift.name: Deadlift
cues: Set your stance and grip so the weight stays close; brace before lifting.
Push through the floor to stand tall, then lower by bending hips and knees.
avoid: Avoid yanking the weight from the floor or leaning back at the top.

dead-bug.name: Dead Bug
cues: Lie on your back with arms up and hips and knees bent to about 90 degrees.
Extend one arm and the opposite leg, return, then switch sides.
avoid: Avoid letting your lower back lift as the limbs extend.

dumbbell-bench-press.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Set a stable position on the bench and keep wrists over forearms.
Lower the weight toward your chest with control, then press it back up.
avoid: Avoid bouncing the weight or losing control of your shoulder position.

dumbbell-floor-press.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cues: Lie on the floor with a stable grip and elbows comfortably below your wrists.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor lightly, then press up.
avoid: Avoid slamming your elbows into the floor or twisting under the load.

dumbbell-hammer-curl.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
cues: Hold the weights with palms facing inward and elbows near your sides.
Curl without rotating your wrists, then lower slowly.
avoid: Avoid swinging your torso or letting your wrists fold.

dumbbell-lateral-raise.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Start with your arms low and elbows softly bent.
Raise your arms out to a comfortable shoulder height, then lower slowly.
avoid: Avoid shrugging or swinging your torso to lift the load.

dumbbell-romanian-deadlift.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Soften your knees, brace, and move your hips back while keeping the weight close.
Lower to a controlled hamstring stretch, then extend your hips to stand.
avoid: Avoid reaching lower by rounding your back or turning it into a squat.

dumbbell-step-up.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
cues: Place your whole working foot on a stable platform.
Stand through that leg, then step down slowly and with balance.
avoid: Avoid springing off the trailing foot or stepping onto an unstable box.

ez-bar-curl.name: EZ-Bar Curl
cues: Keep your upper arms near your torso and hold the load with steady wrists.
Bend your elbows to lift the load, then lower with control.
avoid: Avoid swinging your torso to move the weight.

face-pull.name: Face Pull
cues: Set the cable or band around face height and take a stable stance.
Pull toward your face with elbows opening outward, then return slowly.
avoid: Avoid leaning back or snapping the handle toward your face.

farmer-carry.name: Farmer Carry
cues: Lift the load securely and stand tall with your trunk braced.
Walk with even steps while keeping the weight under control.
avoid: Avoid leaning heavily to one side or rushing with an insecure grip.

goblet-squat.name: Goblet Squat
cues: Set your feet at a comfortable width; brace and bend your hips and knees together.
Keep your whole foot planted, squat to a controlled depth, then stand.
avoid: Avoid losing foot contact or letting the load pull you out of balance.

hanging-knee-raise.name: Hanging Knee Raise
cues: Hang from a secure bar with your shoulders and trunk engaged.
Raise your knees or legs toward your torso, then lower slowly.
avoid: Avoid swinging to lift your legs or dropping into the bottom.

incline-barbell-bench-press.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
cues: Set a stable position on the bench and keep wrists over forearms.
Lower the weight toward your chest with control, then press it back up.
avoid: Avoid bouncing the weight or losing control of your shoulder position.

incline-dumbbell-curl.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cues: Sit back against the incline bench with arms hanging by your sides.
Curl without lifting your upper arms, then lower slowly.
avoid: Avoid leaning off the bench or swinging the weights.

incline-dumbbell-press.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cues: Set a stable position on the bench and keep wrists over forearms.
Lower the weight toward your chest with control, then press it back up.
avoid: Avoid bouncing the weight or losing control of your shoulder position.

jump-rope.name: Jump Rope
cues: Turn the rope mainly from your wrists and keep your jumps low.
Land softly with a steady rhythm and relaxed knees.
avoid: Avoid jumping much higher than needed or landing stiff-legged.

kettlebell-swing.name: Kettlebell Swing
cues: Hike the kettlebell between your legs and drive your hips forward.
Let the bell float from hip power, then hinge as it swings back.
avoid: Avoid lifting it mainly with your arms or leaning back at the top.

kneeling-cable-crunch.name: Kneeling Cable Crunch
cues: Kneel facing the high cable with the rope held near your head.
Curl your ribs toward your pelvis, then return slowly.
avoid: Avoid pulling mainly with your arms or swinging your hips.

lat-pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown
cues: Set a stable seat or stance and take a comfortable grip on the handle.
Pull toward your upper chest, then let your arms rise slowly.
avoid: Avoid throwing your torso backward or pulling behind your neck.

leg-extension.name: Leg Extension
cues: Align your knees with the machine pivot and place the pad above your ankles.
Straighten your knees smoothly, then lower the lever with control.
avoid: Avoid kicking the weight up or letting the stack slam.

leg-press.name: Leg Press
cues: Set a stable foot position on the platform and keep hips against the seat.
Lower the sled as far as you can keep your pelvis stable, then press it away.
avoid: Avoid letting your pelvis lift or snapping your knees straight.

lying-leg-curl.name: Lying Leg Curl

avoid: Avoid lifting your hips off the support or letting the stack slam.

one-arm-dumbbell-row.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row

Pull toward your lower ribs or waist, then lower until your arms extend.
avoid: Avoid standing upright on each rep or jerking the weight.

cues: Hold the load overhead with elbows aimed generally forward and trunk braced.

avoid: Avoid arching your lower back or letting the load fall behind you.

avoid: Avoid twisting toward the anchor or leaning to counter the load.

pec-deck-fly.name: Pec Deck Fly

avoid: Avoid letting the machine pull your shoulders far behind you.

avoid: Avoid swinging to clear the bar or craning your neck for extra height.

avoid: Avoid swinging to clear the bar or craning your neck for extra height.

avoid: Avoid sagging at the hips or losing control of the handles or rings.

avoid: Avoid swinging your shoulders or leaning your body weight onto the handle.

seated-leg-curl.name: Seated Leg Curl

avoid: Avoid lifting your hips off the support or letting the stack slam.

avoid: Avoid swinging your shoulders or leaning your body weight onto the handle.

avoid: Avoid letting your pelvis lift or snapping your knees straight.

avoid: Avoid rocking off the step or losing your balance.

avoid: Avoid throwing your torso upward or arching past a comfortable top position.

avoid: Avoid bouncing or moving your hips to lift the heels.
